evidence_categories.A_SYN: Explicit nonhistorical base prior or rehearsal; literal permitted policies are actual consumer inputs.
evidence_categories.E0: Attributed historical subject/time/context; original authority preserved.
evidence_categories.E_INF: Revisable grounded inference with support and conditions.

local_layout_check: All 80 target layouts checked with a fictional provider; no local private Gemma features or gradients.
scope_limit: Finite initial governing curriculum; counts and mechanical checks do not establish full ALICE capability.
source_permission_audit: Two context-restricted historical units excluded from identity authority; original bodies and contextual authority preserved.
supervision: Root primary teacher; sparse named conditional facts; source-person, host, relationship and AI-self kept distinct; shared teacher ancestry disclosed.
unknown_targets: Untaught uncertainty, outcome/fidelity and numeric acoustic facts remain unavailable.
